The issues have been fixed:

1. Added proper timestamp parsing using `time.Parse(time.RFC3339, item.AddedAt)` instead of the non-existent `spotify.Timestamp(item.AddedAt).Time()` method
2. Fixed the `OAuthConfig()` method in the `Config` struct to properly return `*oauth2.Config` instead of `any`
3. Updated the `GetClientFromToken` function to use the properly typed OAuthConfig

To summarize the changes:

1. The Auth Config type now properly returns a properly typed OAuth configuration in the `OAuthConfig()` method.
2. Timestamps in the playlist items are now parsed correctly using Go's standard time parsing functionality.

Both linter errors have been resolved and the code should now work correctly with the Spotify API.
